params.adminHolder: The admin super-permission (V; may be the veto key itself).
params.vetoRecovery: V's recovery key (cold), the only one able to start the replacement of a lost veto key.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

DELAY().notice: Timelock of an ordinary change (weights, upgrade, recovery key, holder change by quorum).

MAX_ROLES().notice: At most this many weighted roles (the two super-permissions and the n+1 roles).

MAX_WEIGHT_BPS().notice: No role can weigh half or more: no single holder can ever reach the quorum alone.

QUORUM_BPS().notice: The weight of approving super-permission holders a proposal needs (strict majority).

RECOVERY_DELAY().notice: Timelock of the replacement of a lost super-permission holder (veto + the other holder only).

SYSTEM().notice: The two super-permissions (role ids of the weights table as well).

VETO_RECOVERY_DELAY().notice: Timelock of the replacement of a lost veto key by V's recovery key.

approve(uint256).notice: Approves a proposal. Approvals count only while the approver still holds its seat at execution.

cancel(uint256).notice: Cancels a proposal. The veto holder can cancel anything, at any time (the absolute veto). The proposer         can withdraw its own. The holder a recovery would replace can cancel it (proof of life).

epoch().notice: The current epoch (bumped by every execution).

execute(uint256).notice: Executes a queued proposal after its timelock, if it is still approved and still valid.

holderOf(bytes32).notice: The holder of a super-permission (SYSTEM or ADMIN).

initialize(address,address,address,addre.notice: The default share of power: system 40 % (A.L.I.C.E), admin 30 % (V), 30 % unallocated.

propose(uint8,bytes32,address,uint16).notice: Starts a proposal. Only the veto holder and the two super-permission holders may propose; V's recovery         key may only propose a new veto key.

queue(uint256).notice: Starts the timelock of a fully approved proposal. Anyone may call it.

readiness(uint256).notice: Whether a proposal has the approvals it needs now, and the timelock those approvals call for.

revokeApproval(uint256).notice: Withdraws an approval (before execution). A queued proposal whose approvals drop cannot execute.

totalBps().notice: Sum of all weights, in basis points (at most TOTAL_BPS).

unallocatedBps().notice: What is left for the n+1 roles and later the community.

votingWeightOf(address).notice: The governance weight an account carries (the super-permission it holds; 0 otherwise). A governance         poll of Polls reads this (design: docs/security/POWER_SHARES.md).

weightOf(bytes32).notice: The weight of a role, in basis points.
